tools.name: which_park_today
tools.description: Ranks the four Walt Disney World theme parks for visiting right now, combining live crowd levels, today's forecast and remaining park hours. Returns each park's rank, live average wait, open/close times and a one-line reason.

tools.name: get_live_wait_times
tools.description: Current posted wait times for Walt Disney World attractions plus SupaPark's Real Wait estimate of the actual wait (a model calibrated on a public 2018-2019 posted-vs-actual dataset), a low/high range, confidence, and a flag for "ghost" waits that are posted but not real. Refreshes every few minutes

tools.name: get_crowd_forecast
tools.description: Day-by-day crowd forecast for one Walt Disney World park: a 0-100 crowd index, a label (low/moderate/high…) and the drivers behind it (holidays, events, school breaks). Covers the next few weeks when no dates are given.

tools.name: get_dining_drop_odds
tools.description: For hard-to-book Walt Disney World restaurants: how often cancelled reservations reappear ("drops"), the probability of catching one, and the best day-of-week and hour to look.

tools.name: get_lightning_lane_prices
tools.description: Today's Lightning Lane Single Pass prices per attraction at a Walt Disney World park, with 30-day min/median/max, the current posted wait, minutes saved per dollar and a value verdict (e.g. "great deal").

tools.name: get_multi_pass_price
tools.description: The Lightning Lane Multi Pass price for a Walt Disney World park on a given date (defaults to today).

tools.name: get_attraction_details
tools.description: Details for one Walt Disney World attraction (height requirement, land, thrill level, Lightning Lane tier) plus its recent wait-time history and downtime. Takes an attraction slug, e.g. "space-mountain".

tools.name: get_lightning_lane_sellouts
tools.description: When each Walt Disney World ride's Lightning Lane sold out, measured by SupaPark. range "today": today's sellout times so far (or "still available"). range "week": the typical sellout time over the last seven complete days, with how many days sold out and how many were gone before 7:00 AM. tools.name: get_hardest_dining_reservations
tools.description: Walt Disney World restaurants ranked by how rarely a reservation opens, from SupaPark's own availability checks: difficulty tier, the share of checks that found a table, and cancellations ("drops") caught in the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Shows whether this assistant is linked to a SupaPark account, the plan (free, silver or gold) and how alerts are delivered. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

tools.name: list_my_watches
tools.description: Lists the active ride and dining watches (alerts) on the linked SupaPark account, with each watch's id. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

tools.name: watch_ride
tools.description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account for a Walt Disney World ride. kind "lightning_lane": alert when Lightning Lane return times open up (optionally for a specific date). kind "wait_drop": alert when the standby wait drops to threshold_minutes or less. Delivery channel follows the account

tools.name: watch_dining
tools.description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account that fires when a reservation opens at a Walt Disney World restaurant for the given date and party size. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Turns off one watch on the linked SupaPark account, by watch id. It can be restored in the SupaPark app. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).
